title: Summit Elite Benefits Guide — Summit Club Membership as a Choice Benefit
content:
A Summit Diamond or Summit Chairman member who takes the club membership as a choice benefit receives a Summit Club Individual membership from the Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships range. It is recorded with the enrollment source of an elite choice benefit and settled with the benefit payment method at no charge, for one membership year. Only memberships that may be granted as a Summit choice benefit can be granted this way.

A benefit membership is granted only when the customer holds no other lounge membership in pending, active or grace status; a member who already holds one receives no refund or extension in its place.

At the end of the benefit year the membership lapses unless the member pays renewal dues, since a membership granted as a choice benefit does not renew automatically at the member's expense.

## The benefit at a glance

| Element | As granted |
|---|---|
| Who receives it | A Summit Diamond or Summit Chairman member who takes the club membership as a choice benefit |
| Membership granted | Summit Club Individual |
| How it is recorded | Enrollment source: elite choice benefit; settlement: benefit payment method |
| Charge to the member | None |
| Term | One membership year |
| At the end of the benefit year | Lapses unless the member pays renewal dues |

## Conditions, illustrated (hypothetical members)

| Member's records | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Summit Diamond; takes the club membership as a choice benefit; no lounge membership in pending, active or grace status | A Summit Club Individual membership is granted at no charge for one membership year |
| Summit Chairman; takes the club membership as a choice benefit; already holds an active Summit Club Essential membership | No benefit membership is granted, and no refund or extension of the Summit Club Essential membership is given in its place |
| Benefit membership reaching the end of its benefit year, renewal dues unpaid | The membership lapses |
